QuestInfo.name: Signs of Forbidden Magic
QuestInfo.1: Krag detected forbidden magic on traces of the zombies, suggesting that this magic is increasing their numbers. He says he needs more samples, and requests #b#t4000069# x100#k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered 100 Zombie's Lost Teeth to Krag.

0.0: The Coolie Zombies should lay off for awhile, but I still want to know what made their numbers explode like that. I started sniffing around their remains, gross as that sounds, and found something interesting.
0.1: I was able to detect forbidden magic, but it was too weak to track. I have a feeling forbidden magice caused the sudden increase in zombies. I should be able to track it if I have enough samples... Could you help me?

yes.0: I was able to detect forbidden magic from the #b#t4000069#s#k from Coolie Zombies. Each one exudes faint traces of the magic, but I should be able to track it if I have enough samples. Bring me #b100#k #t4000069#s.

no.0: What, are you getting scared now of all times?
